loadFailedText: Check your connection and try again.

export.title: Export your data
export.intro: Take a copy of everything you have tracked.
export.counts: You have {habits, plural, one {# habit} other {# habits}}, {ticks, plural, one {# check-in} other {# check-ins}} and {focusSessions, plural, one {# focus session} other {# focus sessions}}.
export.jsonHint: Everything, for backups and other tools
export.pdfHint: A report to read and share (cannot be imported)
export.overLimit: This is more than Cadence can import back (up to {habits} habits, {ticks} check-ins and {focusSessions} focus sessions). The export is complete, but restoring it here would be refused.
export.failed: Couldn't make the export. Try again.

import.title: Import your data
import.intro: Restore a Cadence backup from a .json or .csv file.
import.limits: Up to {size}, {habits} habits, {ticks} check-ins and {focusSessions} focus sessions.
import.contents: This file has {habits, plural, one {# habit} other {# habits}}, {ticks, plural, one {# check-in} other {# check-ins}} and {focusSessions, plural, one {# focus session} other {# focus sessions}}.
import.warning: This replaces all your current habits and history with what is in this file. It can't be undone.
import.done: Restored {habits, plural, one {# habit} other {# habits}} and {ticks, plural, one {# check-in} other {# check-ins}}.

errors.newerVersion: That backup was made by a newer version of Cadence. Update Cadence and try again.
errors.tooMany: That file has {count} {what, select, habits {habits} ticks {check-ins} other {focus sessions}}. The limit is {limit}.
errors.invalid: That file has a problem in {where}: {reason}.
errors.badCsv: Row {row} of that file isn't valid ({reason}).
errors.badCsvDate: Row {row} has a date Cadence can't read: “{value}”. Dates look like 2026-09-02.

reasons.nameInvalid: the name is empty or too long
reasons.iconInvalid: the icon is not a single emoji
reasons.colorInvalid: the colour isn't one Cadence has
reasons.linkInvalid: a link isn't a web address, or there are too many
reasons.tickBeforeStart: a check-in is before the habit started
reasons.pauseInvalid: a pause ends before it starts
reasons.archiveInvalid: the archived date and the pauses don't match

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.intro: This permanently deletes your habits, history, focus sessions, uploaded files and your sign-in. Export your data first if you want to keep it.
delete.warning: Everything is deleted at once and can't be brought back.
delete.type: Type your email address to confirm

report.subtitle: Progress report
report.heading: Habits of {name}
report.empty: No habits yet. Add one in Cadence and your report will fill in.

signIn.title: Sign-in
signIn.intro: How you get into this account.
signIn.hint: At least 8 characters. There is no password reset, so keep it somewhere safe.
